In this episode of Discover La Jolla, I had the privilege of speaking with Bill Kellogg, President of the La Jolla Beach & Tennis Club. Bill shares the remarkable history of La Jolla Shores and the Kellogg family's long-standing role in shaping and preserving this iconic coastal community.

As we discuss the heritage and evolution of La Jolla, we also highlight the importance of protecting the La Jolla Cove, part of the Matlahuayl State Marine Reserve, also known as the San Diego La Jolla Underwater Park. This year’s 4th of July celebration will feature the drone show, a creative and thoughtful way to honor the area’s natural beauty while bringing the community together for something truly special. I’m currently working to raise funds to help continue this tradition and ensure we preserve what makes this place so unique.

Listen to the full episode here: https://lnkd.in/gWP5ewBd

To learn more or contribute to the preservation effort, visit: ljsteam.org

data.headline: Realtor & Luxury Home Rehabilitation Specialist
data.location: San Diego County, California, United States
data.about:
I am a La Jolla native and active Realtor specializing in the Coastal La Jolla & San Diego real estate market, with combined sales topping $365+million, with expertise in Investment and Luxury Rehab. 

I am known to say, “Real estate never sleeps” and work tirelessly around the clock and my commitment to my clients has earned respect from my colleagues and clients alike. 

Most recently I earned the Circle of Excellence Platinum Award in 2021 - the highest award for closing over $50M by the San Diego Association of Realtors and SD Union Tribune, in addition to some the following accolades:

- “Best Real Estate Agent in La Jolla" by La Jolla Light (October, 2005)
- The Chairman Circle Gold Award (2005)
- The Platinum Sales Award (2006)
- The Leading Edge Society Award (2007, 2009 & 2010)
- The Honor Circle Award (2008)
- Platinum Award (2011 - 2014)
- Top Producers Group (2026)

I pride myself on being knowledgeable of the area and its history and I work diligently to stay informed about the marketplace both locally and nationally, informing my clients of current market trends that may affect their real estate decisions. 

My ultimate goal is to protect YOUR personal investments.

I am backed by "The Jim McInerney Real Estate Team," including multiple sales associates, marketing staff, a short sale negotiator, transaction coordinator, and an office manager, all of whom provide “white glove” service to every client. It’s nice to have peace of mind during the escrow process.
